d:
Anant sinh ki beti shivangi ki haldi seremni shuru ho gaee hai. samne aae vidiyo men parivar aur rishtedar pile rang ke kapron men najar aae. haldi seremni ke lie shandar stej aur khane-pine ke bhavy intjam kiya gaya hai.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
